items.description: 'Ci attaccano perchè li stiamo affrontando, nessuna marcia indietro contro il terrorismo'

items.title: Israeli air strike kills senior Hamas security official in Gaza
items.description: Naim Abu Nahl, 50, was killed in a crowded area while four others, including a Palestinian woman, were wounded.

items.title: Is North Korea holding back on sending Russia more troops?
items.description: A North Korean troop buildup Ukraine warned about months ago has yet to materialize, even as strategic cooperation continues. Analysts say Pyongyang is balancing its ties with Moscow and Beijing.

items.title: Malaysia to send thousands of migrants back to Myanmar as PM acknowledges junta’s ‘atrocities’

items.title: First Eastern Europe, now Libya: The Ukraine war expands its reach
items.description: More sophisticated military technology developed by Ukraine, and suspected Russian message-sending, are expanding the borders of the Ukraine war.

items.title: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
items.description: Ukraine's sinking of a Russian battleship at a port in Libya raises the stakes of the war a notch, writes Frank Gardner.

items.title: More Than 700,000 Russian Soldiers Killed In Ukraine War, New Analysis Finds
items.description: More than 700,000 Russian soldiers have been killed during the nearly-five-year-old war on Ukraine, according to a new analysis, a staggering figure that highlights Moscow's intent on conquering Ukrainian territory -- and Ukraine's intent on inflicting mass casualties.

items.title: Attacks on two Russian ships in Libyan waters mark new turn in Ukraine war
items.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky claimed seven naval drones carried out two attacks off the coast of Benghazi. The attack on Russian vessels transporting weaponry demonstrates Kyiv's capacity to strike Moscow's interests wherever they might be.

items.title: Gaza war has undone 77 years of human development, UN warns
items.description: The UN deputy chief urged renewed international support for a two-State solution to the Israel-Palestine conflict on Monday, warning that Palestinians continue to face violence, displacement and dire living conditions despite the October 2025 ceasefire in Gaza.

items.title: 3 Killed in Russian Strike on Private Clinic in Zaporizhzhia
items.description: Three people were killed in a Russian strike on a private clinic in Zaporizhzhia on Monday, while attacks across Ukraine caused further casualties and damage to civilian infrastructure.

items.title: Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship docked at a naval base in Libya
items.description: Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, claiming that sea drones sank the navy vessel in a surprise assault.

items.title: Libya’s Eastern Government Suspects Drone Attack Caused Explosion on Russian Ship
items.description: The government stressed that Libya was not a party to the war between Russia and Ukraine, saying its relations with friendly countries were a sovereign matter.
